$comment: Local Supabase rehearsal: every tests/*.local-integration.test.* file is listed once, under run or excluded. scripts/supabase-rehearsal.sh runs the run list against the disposable stack and fails when a listed file skips a test or runs none. tests/supabase-rehearsal-diagnostics.test.ts enforces the classification.

excluded.tests/acceptance-oauth-driver.local-inte: Needs CADENCE_ACCEPT_248_LOCAL=1 and a running app server with its own issuer, CA file and app log.
excluded.tests/apple-sign-in.local-integration.te: Needs an app server (CADENCE_APPLE_SIGN_IN_E2E_URL), the Apple stub and CADENCE_SIGN_IN_APPLE.
excluded.tests/auth-callback-rate-limit.local-int: Needs an app server (CADENCE_CALLBACK_E2E_URL) and a rate-limit gateway.
excluded.tests/behavior-configuration-events.loca: Needs CADENCE_LOCAL_HISTORY_USER_ID: a user pre-seeded with 1,001 configuration events, which the rehearsal does not create.
excluded.tests/calendar-google-sign-in.local-inte: Needs an app server (CADENCE_CALENDAR_SIGN_IN_E2E_URL) and Google Calendar sign-in settings.
Needs an app server (CADENCE_DESKTOP_SIGN_IN_E2E_URL) and Chrome.
excluded.tests/email-sign-in-rate-limit.local-int: Needs an app server (CADENCE_RATE_LIMIT_E2E_URL) and a rate-limit gateway.
excluded.tests/email-sign-in.local-integration.te: Needs an app server (CADENCE_EMAIL_SIGN_IN_E2E_URL) and CADENCE_SIGN_IN_EMAIL.
excluded.tests/mcp-fixture-archive-partial.local-: Needs CADENCE_MCP_ARCHIVE_REHEARSAL=1 and its own isolated MCP project.
excluded.tests/mcp-fixture-cleanup-client-creatio: Needs CADENCE_ACCEPT_CLEANUP_LOCAL=1 and CADENCE_LOCAL_DB_CONTAINER for docker exec, which the rehearsal's Docker proxy refuses.
excluded.tests/mcp-hosted-fixtures.local-integrat: Needs CADENCE_MCP_FIXTURE_REHEARSAL=1, a rehearsal receipt and its own isolated MCP project.
excluded.tests/mcp-hosted-isolation.local-integra: Needs CADENCE_MCP_HOSTED_ISOLATION_LOCAL=1 and the cadence-mcp-232 project on ports 56120-56129.
Reads its database on a hard-coded port 56922 (a separate isolated project), not the rehearsal's 55322.
excluded.tests/mcp-session-broker.local-integrati: Needs CADENCE_QA_BROKER_LOCAL=1 and the QA session broker.
excluded.tests/oauth-maintenance.local-integratio: Needs CADENCE_OAUTH_MAINTENANCE_LOCAL=1 and the cadence-mcp-232 project (container and port 56121 are hard-coded), and runs docker exec.
excluded.tests/session-refresh-rate-limit.local-i: Needs an app server (CADENCE_REFRESH_E2E_URL) and a rate-limit gateway.
Needs an app server (CADENCE_SIGN_IN_METHODS_E2E_URL) and the sign-in flags.
